name: SESSION-EVENT-RELAY-CONFIG
environment: KNODE_SESSION_EVENTS_PROBE_PREFIX (required when enabled; unique probe key is prefix:UUID, max prefix length 218)
credentials: Use a dedicated event identity distinct from session read and write identities. No production in-memory publisher. Redis credential and private values must be injected externally.
probe: Every probe uses a unique <configured-prefix>:<UUID> key: MULTI, XADD probe 1, EXPIRE 10, EXEC, then DEL that exact key. Concurrent checks cannot delete one another. Expiry commits atomically with creation; no synthetic event is added to the business event stream. Probe-prefix ACL does not prove target-key ACL.

minimumAcl.connection: Client authentication, SELECT if a nonzero DB is explicitly used, and client handshake commands as required by driver/server. No ACL SETUSER/DELUSER is issued.

realTest.guard: Explicit verify- environment, empty MySQL schema on 127.0.0.1 non-3306 port, and event prefix strictly under knode:<verify-environment>:v1:business:
realTest.cleanup: The random test event stream is deleted by exact key; every unique probe is deleted by its own caller and otherwise expires after 10 seconds. No scans or ACL mutations.

legacyProbeConfiguration: KNODE_SESSION_EVENTS_PROBE_KEY remains accepted as a deprecated prefix alias; set only one of PREFIX or KEY. ACL must allow the prefix plus :UUID.
retryPolicyRollout: Apply the same maximum-attempts setting to all relay workers; during a mixed-configuration rollout, an older worker may still claim under its own higher limit.
